experiences.name: Northern Lights Hunt from Reykjavik
experiences.description: Join a guided minibus tour departing from central Reykjavik to chase the aurora borealis. Expert guides use real-time forecasts to find the clearest skies, taking you to dark spots around the Reykjanes Peninsula or beyond the city light pollution for optimal viewing.

experiences.name: Blue Lagoon Geothermal Spa
experiences.description: Soak in the world-famous milky-blue geothermal waters of the Blue Lagoon, rich in silica and minerals. Located just 20 minutes from Reykjavik and close to Keflavik Airport, this iconic hot spring experience includes access to steam rooms, a lava cave, and optional in-water massages.

experiences.name: Golden Circle Day Tour
experiences.description: Explore Iceland's most celebrated natural route covering Thingvellir National Park (a UNESCO World Heritage Site where tectonic plates meet), the erupting Strokkur geyser at the Geysir Geothermal Area, and the majestic Gullfoss waterfall. Many tours depart directly from Reykjavik hotels.

experiences.name: Secret Lagoon Natural Hot Spring
experiences.description: Visit Iceland's oldest swimming pool, a naturally heated geothermal pool in the small village of Fludir, conveniently located along the Golden Circle route. Far less crowded than the Blue Lagoon, it offers an authentic and relaxing soak surrounded by steaming geysers and lush countryside.

experiences.name: Snorkeling or Diving in Silfra Fissure
experiences.description: Snorkel or dive between the North American and Eurasian tectonic plates in the crystal-clear glacial waters of Silfra, located within Thingvellir National Park. The visibility exceeds 100 meters in some of the world's purest water. Guided tours include all gear and are accessible from Reykjavik as a day trip.
